user.title: Advanced Climate
user.description: Create the house. Rooms are added afterwards with "Add room"; all other options are in the integration options.

data_description.name: Shown on the devices and in the card.
data_description.persons: People whose location decides home / nearby / far. Leave empty only if presence should not matter: the house is then always 'home' and only the schedule decides.
data_description.nearby_zones: Zones where the house counts as 'nearby' (eco), e.g. your city. Outside home and every zone = 'far' (away). Leave empty if you only want home / far.
data_description.home_rule: 'At least one' suits most homes. 'Everybody' lowers the heating as soon as one person leaves.

heating.title: Heating of the whole house
heating.description: The thermostat (or relay) that heats the whole house. It becomes the zone {zone} and works with every option of the house. Rooms with their own valves can be added later with "Add room".

data_description.source: What heats the whole house. Pick 'No heating devices yet' if you will only add rooms with their own valves.
data_description.climates: The thermostat that controls the boiler, e.g. the Generic Thermostat entity (climate.climate).
data_description.switches: Only when a relay heats the house directly, without a thermostat.
data_description.command_mode: Only for thermostats other than Generic Thermostat. See the room settings for the difference.

heating.title: Heating of the whole house
heating.description: The thermostat (or relay) that heats the whole house. It becomes the zone {zone} and works with every option of the house. Rooms with their own valves can be added later with "Add room".

data_description.source: What heats the whole house. Pick 'No heating devices yet' if you will only add rooms with their own valves.
data_description.climates: The thermostat that controls the boiler, e.g. the Generic Thermostat entity (climate.climate).
data_description.switches: Only when a relay heats the house directly, without a thermostat.
data_description.command_mode: Only for thermostats other than Generic Thermostat. See the room settings for the difference.

data_description.persons: People whose location decides home / nearby / far. Leave empty only if presence should not matter: the house is then always 'home' and only the schedule decides.
data_description.home_rule: 'At least one' suits most homes. 'Everybody' lowers the heating as soon as one person leaves.
data_description.nearby_zones: Zones where the house counts as 'nearby' (eco), e.g. your city. Outside home and every zone = 'far' (away). Leave empty if you only want home / far.
data_description.nearby_geometric: Uses the GPS coordinates: someone in a zone that lies inside a nearby zone (e.g. Office in the city) counts as nearby. Turn off if people have no GPS location.
data_description.departure_delay: How long everybody must be gone before the heating is lowered. Avoids reacting to short trips (shop, walking the dog).
data_description.arrival_delay: Usually 0: the heating returns as soon as someone is home. Raise it only if GPS sometimes reports 'home' by mistake.
data_description.presence_sensors: Keep the house 'home' while on (mmWave, motion, a switch for people without a phone). Leave empty if everybody has the companion app.
data_description.guest_expire_hours: Guest mode keeps the house 'home'; it turns off by itself after this many hours. 0 = only manually.
data_description.proximity_distance: Proximity integration distance sensor, for preheating on the way home. Leave empty without Proximity.
data_description.proximity_direction: Proximity direction sensor. Set it so that sitting at an office near home does not start the preheating.
data_description.travel_time: Travel time to home (Waze, Google Travel Time) for preheating. Leave empty if you do not have one.
data_description.arrival_distance: Preheating starts when someone is closer than this (with the distance sensor).
data_description.arrival_minutes: Preheating starts when someone is closer than this many minutes (with the travel time sensor).

data_description.workday_sensor: Workday integration sensor, so holidays use the weekend profile. Without it Mon–Fri are workdays.
data_description.calendar: Optional. An event titled with a profile name (e.g. home_office) or a level name (e.g. away) applies it while the event lasts. Leave empty if you do not plan days in a calendar.
data_description.day_boundary: Leave 00:00. Change it only for night shifts, so a night belongs to the previous day.

data.cutoff_enabled: Turn heating off when it is warm outside

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Outdoor temperature for the cutoff, season and compensation. If empty, the weather entity temperature is used.
data_description.weather: Used for the forecast, for the solar gain and as outdoor temperature when there is no sensor.
data_description.cutoff_enabled: Stops heating when the outdoor average is above the cutoff temperature. Needs an outdoor sensor or a weather entity.
data_description.cutoff_temp: Heating stops above this average outdoor temperature.
data_description.cutoff_hysteresis: Heating starts again only below cutoff minus this value, so it does not flip around the cutoff.
data_description.cutoff_avg_hours: The cutoff uses the average of the last hours, so a sunny afternoon does not stop the heating.
data_description.forecast_enabled: Delays heating when the forecast says it will be warm soon. Needs a weather entity with an hourly forecast.
data_description.forecast_hours: How many hours of forecast are checked.
data_description.season_mode: 'Always' if you switch the season with the Summer mode. 'Between dates' or 'Automatic' to stop heating outside the season by itself.
data_description.season_start: Only for 'Between dates'. Month and day, e.g. 10-15.
data_description.season_end: Only for 'Between dates'. Month and day, e.g. 04-15.
data_description.season_days: Only for 'Automatic': days in a row below (or above) the threshold before the season starts (or ends).
data_description.season_temp: Only for 'Automatic': daily average outdoor temperature that starts or ends the season.
data_description.compensation_enabled: Raises the target a little when it is very cold outside (walls are colder). Leave off if the rooms keep the temperature well.
data_description.compensation_below: Outdoor temperature below which the compensation is added.
data_description.window_ignore_above: Open windows do not lower the heating when it is this warm outside. Leave empty to always react.

data_description.price_sensor: Energy price sensor (dynamic tariff). Leave empty with a fixed price.
data_description.price_high: At or above this price the high-price adjustment is applied.
data_description.price_high_offset: Usually negative, e.g. -1 °C while energy is expensive.
data_description.price_low: At or below this price the low-price adjustment is applied.
data_description.price_low_offset: Usually positive, e.g. +1 °C while energy is cheap (electric heating, heat pump).
data_description.pv_sensor: Power exported to the grid (W). Only useful with electric heating or a heat pump.
data_description.pv_threshold: Surplus from which the adjustment is applied.
data_description.pv_offset: Degrees added while there is surplus (e.g. +1).

boiler.title: Boiler and heat demand

data.boiler_min_rooms: Rooms needed to start the boiler
data.room_diff_alert: Alert when a room stays colder than

data_description.boiler_entity: Only when the rooms cannot start the boiler themselves (TRVs, zone valves). Leave empty with Generic Thermostat or a relay on the boiler, and never pick the relay Generic Thermostat already uses.
data_description.boiler_min_rooms: With a boiler: how many rooms must ask for heat to start it. 1 = any room.
data_description.boiler_min_on: With a boiler: minimum run time, against short cycles.
data_description.boiler_min_off: With a boiler: minimum pause between starts.
data_description.room_diff_alert: Alert when one room stays this much below its target while others are warm (stuck valve, open window). 0 = off; useful only with several rooms.
data_description.reference_room: With a boiler: only this room decides when it runs, the others just open or close their valves. Leave empty to use the number of rooms.

boiler.description: Only for houses where the rooms cannot start the boiler themselves (TRVs or zone valves): the integration then starts the boiler when rooms ask for heat. With Generic Thermostat or a relay on the boiler leave the boiler empty; the alert below still works.

data.vacation_preheat_hours: Preheat before the end of a vacation
data.auto_vacation_hours: Automatic vacation after far away for

data_description.override_mode: One rule for every manual change. 'Fixed duration' keeps it for the hours below. 'Until next reevaluation' ends when the schedule, presence, a window or the mode changes; the periodic check does not end it.
data_description.override_scope: 'Only that room' suits most homes. 'Whole house' copies a manual change to every room; use it only when every room has its own valves.
data_description.vacation_preheat_hours: The schedule returns this many hours before the vacation ends, so the house is warm when you arrive.
data_description.auto_vacation_hours: Turns on the vacation by itself after everybody has been far away this long. 0 = only manually.
data_description.frost_temp: Used with an open window or the Off mode. Rooms with Generic Thermostat use its minimum temperature instead.
data_description.max_temp: No level, adjustment or manual change from the integration goes above this.
data_description.reevaluation_minutes: Safety check that resends the decision if a device lost it. Changes are applied immediately anyway; 5–15 minutes is fine.

data.alert_window_minutes: Alert when a window is open longer than
data.alert_unavailable_minutes: Alert when a device is unavailable longer than

data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty for notifications in Home Assistant only.
data_description.alert_window_minutes: Alert when a window stays open this long while heating is needed.
data_description.alert_unavailable_minutes: Alert when a thermostat or sensor is unavailable this long.
data_description.battery_threshold: Alert when the battery of a room device (TRV, sensor) drops below this.
data_description.verify_commands: After 2 minutes checks that the device accepted the command, retries once, then alerts. Turn off only if a device reports its state slowly.

data_description.name: Shown on the devices and in the card.
data_description.area: Optional; links the room to a Home Assistant area.
data_description.source: Generic Thermostat: it keeps its own presets and temperatures, the integration only picks them. Other thermostats / TRVs: set the command in the next step. Relay: the integration switches it on and off itself.

data_description.climates: The thermostats of this room. Several thermostats in one room all get the same command.
data_description.switches: The relays that heat this room.
data_description.command_mode: Temperature: the integration sends the temperature of each level (most TRVs). Preset: each level uses a preset of the thermostat, with the thermostat's temperature. On / off: the thermostat is only switched on and off, the integration keeps the temperature.

control_on_off.title: On / off control
control_on_off.description: The integration switches the heating on and off around the target.

data_description.hysteresis: Heating starts below target minus this value and stops above target plus this value.
data_description.min_on_minutes: Minimum time on. 0 for heaters that do not mind short cycles.
data_description.min_off_minutes: Minimum time off between two starts.

control_thermostat.title: Thermostat
control_thermostat.description: The thermostat keeps the temperature; the integration only sends the level or the temperature.

data_description.learn_tolerance: How far below the target the thermostat lets the room fall before heating (its own tolerance). The heating rate is learned from rises that start at least this below the target.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: The levels have fixed roles: home, sleep, eco (nearby), away (far / vacation), comfort and activity. With preset control, pick the thermostat preset used by each level (presets found: {presets}); the thermostat keeps its temperature. A level without a preset is reached by sending its temperature. With temperature or on/off control, the temperatures below are used and can be changed later from the card.

data.nearby_mode: When nobody is home but someone is nearby

data_description.nearby_mode: Eco preset: uses the eco level. Fixed temperature: sends the temperature below (with Generic Thermostat the preset becomes none).
data_description.name_home: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_sleep: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_eco: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_away: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_comfort: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_activity: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.device_home: Preset of the thermostat used for this level; the thermostat keeps its temperature. Leave empty if the thermostat has no such preset: the temperature of the level below is sent instead (it is also shown when the thermostat does not report the preset temperature).
data_description.device_sleep: Preset of the thermostat used for this level; the thermostat keeps its temperature. Leave empty if the thermostat has no such preset: the temperature of the level below is sent instead (it is also shown when the thermostat does not report the preset temperature).
data_description.device_eco: Preset of the thermostat used for this level; the thermostat keeps its temperature. Leave empty if the thermostat has no such preset: the temperature of the level below is sent instead (it is also shown when the thermostat does not report the preset temperature).
data_description.device_away: Preset of the thermostat used for this level; the thermostat keeps its temperature. Leave empty if the thermostat has no such preset: the temperature of the level below is sent instead (it is also shown when the thermostat does not report the preset temperature).
data_description.device_comfort: Preset of the thermostat used for this level; the thermostat keeps its temperature. Leave empty if the thermostat has no such preset: the temperature of the level below is sent instead (it is also shown when the thermostat does not report the preset temperature).
data_description.device_activity: Preset of the thermostat used for this level; the thermostat keeps its temperature. Leave empty if the thermostat has no such preset: the temperature of the level below is sent instead (it is also shown when the thermostat does not report the preset temperature).
data_description.temp_home: Temperature of this level. Can be changed later from the card.
data_description.temp_sleep: Temperature of this level. Can be changed later from the card.
data_description.temp_eco: Temperature of this level. Can be changed later from the card.
data_description.temp_away: Temperature of this level. Can be changed later from the card.
data_description.temp_comfort: Temperature of this level. Can be changed later from the card.
data_description.temp_activity: Temperature of this level. Can be changed later from the card.

data_description.temperature_sensors: Sensors in the room, used instead of the thermostat sensor (more accurate when the thermostat sits next to a heat source). Leave empty to use the thermostat sensor; needed for relays, which have no sensor.
data_description.temperature_aggregation: Only with several sensors: average, the coldest or the median.
data_description.calibration_mode: Needs a room temperature sensor above. Offset: corrects the TRV sensor. External temperature: writes the room temperature into the TRV (if it supports it). Off otherwise.
data_description.calibration_entities: Only with calibration: the TRV number entities (offset or external temperature).
data_description.occupancy_sensors: Motion / presence sensors of the room: when the room is empty for a while it goes to eco even if someone is home. Leave empty for rooms that should follow only the schedule.
data_description.occupancy_minutes: How long the room must be empty before eco.

data.window_drop_detect: Detect open windows from the temperature

data_description.window_sensors: Windows and doors of this room. Leave empty if there are none (the temperature drop detection below can help).
data_description.linked_window_sensors: Windows of other rooms that also cool this one, e.g. the living room balcony door for the hall.
data_description.window_open_delay: How long a window must be open before the heating reacts. Short airing below this is ignored.
data_description.window_close_delay: How long to wait after closing before heating again.
data_description.window_action: Frost protection keeps a minimum temperature. Turn off stops the heating.
data_description.window_drop_detect: Treats a quick temperature drop as an open window for 15 minutes. Useful for rooms without window sensors.
data_description.window_drop_degrees: Drop that counts as an open window.
data_description.window_drop_minutes: Time in which the drop must happen.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: One profile per line: `profile: HH:MM preset, HH:MM preset`. Profiles: workday, weekend, mon…sun or any name (manual or calendar). {error}

data.helper_on_preset: Level while the helper is on
data.helper_off_preset: Level while the helper is off

data_description.schedule_source: Internal schedule: written here or edited from the card. Schedule helper: a Home Assistant Schedule helper decides between two levels.
data_description.schedule: Only for the internal schedule. e.g. `workday: 00:00 sleep, 06:00 home, 22:00 sleep`. Easier to edit from the card.
data_description.helper_on_preset: Only for 'Schedule helper': level while the helper is on.
data_description.helper_off_preset: Only for 'Schedule helper': level while the helper is off.
data_description.optimal_start: Starts heating early so the next level is reached on time. The heating speed is learned in a few days.
data_description.optimal_stop: Lowers the temperature a little before the next colder level, using the heat already in the walls. Leave off if the rooms cool fast.
data_description.optimal_stop_minutes: How early the lower level starts.

data_description.solar_offset: Negative value (e.g. -1) lowers the target while the sun shines, for rooms that get warm from the sun. 0 = off.
data_description.valve_exercise: Opens the TRVs fully 5 minutes once a week, against limescale.
data_description.valve_exercise_time: Time of the valve exercise (best when nobody needs heat).

error.duplicate_names: Two levels have the same name.

options.any: At least one person is home

entity_id.description: Any entity of the room (or its thermostat).

profiles.description: Profiles as an object: profile name -> list of time and preset (used by the card).
